headline: Citigroup (C) Could Be 14% Undervalued After Its Q2 Earnings Drop
summary: Citigroup (C) has drawn investor attention after its stock fell 7% following second quarter 2026 earnings, even though the bank reported higher net interest income, net income, and diluted earnings per share compared with a year earlier.
